newsitem.title: USA: Intelligent Medical sees settlement charge.
newsitem.headline: Intelligent Medical sees settlement charge.

text.p: Intelligent Medical Imaging Inc said it has settled a dispute with Coulter Corp and will take a one-time non-recurring charge against its 1996 financial statements of $2.3 million.
The dispute was related to the termination of a distribution agreement which provided exclusive sales and distribution rights to Coulter.

As part of the settlement, Coulter may purchase Intelligent Medical's MICRO21 systems on terms as favorable as those provided by the company to other distributors and Coulter has the right to purchase up to 21 MICRO21 systems at a discounted transfer price for placement outside the United States.

Intelligent Medical said it has agreed to pay Coulter $4.2 million in exchange for the return of 26 MICRO21 systems of Coulter's inventory, for the assignment of four of Coulter's customer contracts, and as reimbursement for certain of Coulter's costs and expenses incurred in its sale and marketing of the MICRO21 system subject to certain offsets.
